data.name: Disharmony
data.detailed_description:
DISHARMONY

In 1899, Alexander Voss — occultist and visionary composer — attempted to weave all dimensions together through a single musical masterpiece. The experiment failed. The Universal Symphony shattered, causing worlds to collapse into one another. His Victorian mansion became the epicenter of the catastrophe.

Two centuries later, six of his descendants make a desperate leap back in time to repair the Gramophones and restore the melody before reality unravels forever. But the journey tears through fractured space-time — and at the crossing point, a dark parallel universe bleeds through.

One descendant is struck by a molecular anomaly. A predatory entity from another reality fuses with them.

🎻 RESTORE THE SYMPHONY
Collaborate with 5 survivors and repair the 3 Gramophones scattered across the mansion.

🎭 TRUST NO ONE
Use proximity voice chat to coordinate, strategize… or deceive. There is only one Shovel in the mansion — the single tool capable of forcing The Discordant into a spiritual and less dangerous form. Accuse the wrong person, and you're defenseless.

🌑 PLAY AS THE DISCORDANT
You have 8 minutes to ensure eternal silence. Hide among the survivors in human form. Sabotage the Gramophones.

👻 DEATH IS NOT THE END
Eliminated players become Specters — still bound to the mansion. Fight for your side even after death: guide the living to hidden pieces, or sabotage the mansion into chaos.

3 GRAMOPHONES. 5 SURVIVORS. 1 DISCORDANT.
Will you restore the Symphony — or become part of the eternal silence?

data.short_description: 1899. A composer shatters the Universal Symphony. 2099. His descendants travel back to fix it—but one of them is no longer human. Join forces in co-op for up to 6 players, be careful: The Discordant is among you.

English*, Italian*, German*, Japanese*, Portuguese - Portugal*, Simplified Chinese*, Spanish - Spain*
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (Version 1909+)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 (6GB) / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: A wired (Ethernet) connection is recommended for lobbies hosts to ensure the best experience for all participants.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700 / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: A wired (Ethernet) connection is recommended for lobbies hosts to ensure the best experience for all participants.

content_descriptors.notes: Disharmony features a dark, high-tension atmosphere, blending psychological horror with themes of betrayal and social deception. The game contains moderate violence but avoids graphic splatter or blood-intense scenes.
